summary: ACM Research, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 26, 2026, reporting that its operating subsidiary ACM Shanghai approved a proposal to issue H shares and list on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's Main Board. The filing is a routine disclosure of a non-US subsidiary's board resolution, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, or other event-driven change is announced. The H-share listing remains subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals with no definitive timeline. This is an ordinary update with no actionable special-situation angle.
